Avery: Heads-up — scheduling a dedicated rollout for Meridian Labs tonight 21:00 PT. Objective: pin serving runtime to v2026-03-stable, warm the reserved pool, and validate inference parity on a golden set. Need SRE + Ops final ack. @Sam @Leah
DeployBot: [deploybot] New rollout: meridian-dedicated-pin-v2026-03-stable -> scheduled 2026-03-21T21:00:00-07:00. Canary plan: 6% (8m) -> 30% (12m) -> 100% (20m). Run ID: db-roll-1764444567.
Sam: Please add exact rollback signals here. we had flaky p99 last month and want clear thresholds.
Avery: Rollback triggers in playbook: 1) p99 latency increase >135ms vs baseline for 3 consecutive 1m buckets, 2) error rate >0.9% sustained 4m, 3) semantic drift >1.5% on golden prompts. Auto-halt on trigger -> revert to previous pool. Manual rollback requires two approvers.
Leah: SRE note: include a 90s buffer after each stage before evaluating p99 to avoid false positives from cache churn. I'll run golden-sample checks at 6% and 30%: `redwoodctl eval --tenant meridian --golden 40`.
OpsBot: Ops rota: ops@infra will be pinged. KMS rotation check: none within 72h. Ops will still add a temporary KMS hold pre-final-promote as a precaution. Command: `ops toggle-kms-hold --tenant meridian --until 2026-03-23`.
Cassie: CS notified customer contacts; they asked that the release notes mention the pinned runtime and rollback contact. I pushed notes: https://intranet.redwood/releases/meridian-2026-03-21 (short).
DeployBot: Preflight summary for db-roll-1764444567:
```
- capacity-check: OK (reserved 1.2x required)
- config-validate: OK
- smoke-tests: 10/10 passed
- kv-cache-probe: scheduled at canary start
- canary-policy: 6 -> 30 -> 100
```
Sam: I edited the emergency rollback command to include force-drain: `redwoodctl rollback --tenant meridian --to-version v2026-02.x --force --run-id db-roll-1764444567`. Added to runbook.
Leah: SRE ACK. I'll monitor p99, golden-diff, and prefix-cache hit-rate. Oncall will be watching.
Avery: Ops ACK? final GO/NO-GO at 20:45 PT. I will call for promote after 20m at 100% if metrics stay green. Also logging: capture KV warm timeline and short-signal latency at stage transitions for post-roll notes.
OpsBot: Ops ACK. Oncall and ops-lead notified.
Cassie: Customer ACKed the window.
Avery: Great, thanks. DeployBot proceed as scheduled and auto-halt on triggers. Reopen this thread if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
